ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus 'Operation Dream Job' ISO/LNK job-lure spawning regsvr32/rundll32 DLL proxy + C2
ucs.description: Hunts the Lazarus Group (Hidden Cobra / ZINC / Diamond Sleet) Operation Dream Job delivery chain: a fake recruiter ISO/ZIP containing a decoy 'job description' LNK that, on click via explorer.exe from a mounted-ISO or user-writable path, proxy-executes a payload DLL through regsvr32.exe/rundll32.exe and immediately beacons. Ties the signed-LOLBin execution to first-seen public egress within a tight window — the hallmark of Lazarus's social-engineering-led intrusions against defense/aerospace and crypto targets.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe")) AND (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe")) AND (Processes.process IN ("*\\Users\\*","*\\AppData\\*","*\\Temp\\*","*:\\*.dll*","*-i*") OR Processes.process="*.dll,*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process_id as ppid | join type=inner dest [| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.app IN ("regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe") AND All_Traffic.dest_category!="internal" by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest_ip All_Traffic.dest_port All_Traffic.app | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | rename src as dest] | where lastTime - firstTime < 300 | table firstTime dest user parent_process_name process_name process dest_ip dest_port
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 14d;
let Window = 300;
let Proxy = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName in~ ("regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("explorer.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\Users\", @"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", ".dll")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ProcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FolderPath, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ProxyName = FileName, SHA256;
Proxy
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl
) on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + Window * 1s)   // 300s = lure-click→beacon dwell observed in Dream Job intrusions
| project ProcTime, DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, ProcTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName, ProxyName, ChildCmd, ParentCmd,
          RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl, SHA256
| order by ProcTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 14d;
let Window = 300;
let Proxy = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend Child = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
    | where Child in~ ("regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe")
    | extend Parent = tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])
    | where Parent in~ ("explorer.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe")
    | where CommandLine has_any (@"\Users\", @"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", ".dll")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project ProcTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName, ProxyName = Child, ChildCmd = CommandLine, ParentProcessName;
Proxy
| join kind=inner (
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where ProcessName has_any ("regsvr32","rundll32")
    | where DestinationIP !startswith "10." and DestinationIP !startswith "192.168." and DestinationIP !startswith "172."
    | project NetTime = TimeGenerated, Computer = DeviceName, DestinationIP, DestinationPort, ProcessName
) on Computer
| where NetTime between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + Window * 1s)
| project ProcTime, DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, ProcTime), Computer, Account, ProxyName, ChildCmd, DestinationIP, DestinationPort
| order by ProcTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Lazarus Dream Job LNK Proxy-Execution via Regsvr32/Rundll32 from User Path
id: 8c1f2a4e-7b9d-4e2a-9f1c-3a6b2d8e5c7f
status: experimental
description: Detects regsvr32/rundll32 proxy-executing a DLL from a user-writable or ISO-mount path when spawned by explorer/script host, matching Lazarus Operation Dream Job lures.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1218.010
  - attack.t1218.011
  - attack.g0032
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
  selection_path:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\Users\'
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '.dll'
  condition: selection_img and selection_parent and selection_path
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate installers run from user Downloads
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\explorer.exe OR *\Explorer.EXE OR *\cmd.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe) @Image:(*\regsvr32.exe OR *\Regsvr32.exe OR *\REGSVR32.EXE OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE) @CommandLine:(*\\Users\\* OR *\\AppData\\* OR *\\Temp\\* OR *.dll*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(regsvr32|rundll32)\.exe$/i ParentBaseFileName=/(explorer|cmd|wscript|cscript|powershell)\.exe/i
| regex("\\\\(Users|AppData|Temp)\\\\|\\.dll", field=CommandLine)
| join({#event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4 ContextImageFileName=/\\(regsvr32|rundll32)\.exe$/i | NOT cidr("10.0.0.0/8", field=RemoteAddressIP4) | NOT cidr("192.168.0.0/16", field=RemoteAddressIP4)}, field=aid, include=[RemoteAddressIP4, RemotePort])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, RemoteAddressIP4, RemotePort], function=count())

_sentinel_field_issues.message: `DeviceName` is not a column of CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent; it does exist on DeviceProcessEvents, DeviceNetworkEvents, DeviceFileEvents, DeviceRegistryEvents, DeviceLogonEvents, DeviceImageLoadEvents, DeviceEvents, DeviceInfo, DeviceNetworkInfo, IdentityLogonEvents, IdentityQueryEvents, IdentityDirectoryEvents, DeviceTvmSoftwareInventory, DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities, AlertEvidence, AADSignInEventsBeta, ASCDeviceEvents.

ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus DLL side-loading into a signed legitimate binary (AppleJeus / 3CX / MagicLine tradecraft)
ucs.description: Hunts Lazarus Group's signature DLL search-order hijack: a legitimately signed third-party executable (trojanized trading/PDF/VPN/comms app) loading an unsigned or company-mismatched DLL from a user-writable directory. This is the execution primitive behind AppleJeus crypto-theft installers, the 3CXDesktopApp supply-chain implant, and MagicLine4NX abuse — Lazarus repeatedly relies on side-loading to run code under a trusted, signed parent.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="*.dll" AND (Filesystem.file_path IN ("*\\Users\\*","*\\AppData\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*","*\\Temp\\*")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_name _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | search process_name!="msiexec.exe" process_name!="TiWorker.exe" process_name!="setup.exe" | rename process_name as loader_process | join type=inner dest file_name [| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name!="rundll32.exe" by Processes.dest Processes.process_name Processes.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process_name as file_name] | table firstTime dest loader_process file_name file_path
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 14d;
// Trusted, commonly-abused signed loaders Lazarus has hijacked + signed apps in general
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where FileName endswith ".dll"
// DLL resident in a user-writable directory (side-load staging), not System32/WinSxS
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\Users\", @"\AppData\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Temp\", @"\Public\")
| where FolderPath !has @"\Windows\"
// Loader is itself signed by a real vendor (the trust Lazarus borrows) but the DLL company differs / is blank
| where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName)
| extend LoaderCompany = InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\Users\", @"\AppData\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Program Files\")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          LoaderExe = InitiatingProcessFileName, LoaderCompany,
          LoaderPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          SideLoadedDll = FileName, DllPath = FolderPath,
          DllSHA256 = SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc

id: 4d9e6b21-2c7a-4f83-bb1e-9a5c0e7d3f48
status: experimental
description: Detects a signed executable loading a DLL from a user-writable directory outside Windows, matching Lazarus AppleJeus/3CX/MagicLine DLL search-order hijack tradecraft.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1574/002/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.privilege_escalation
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.g0032
logsource:
  category: image_load
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_dll:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '.dll'
  selection_path:
    ImageLoaded|contains:
      - '\Users\'
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\Public\'
  filter_windows:
    ImageLoaded|contains: '\Windows\'
  filter_signed_dll:
    Signed: 'true'
    SignatureStatus: 'Valid'
  condition: selection_dll and selection_path and not filter_windows and not filter_signed_dll
falsepositives:
  - Portable apps and dev tools loading bundled DLLs from user directories
level: medium
